summary: Seal Fate Swords for a Humanoid or Giant boss, with Murder 2/2 (+4% damage to Humanoids and Giants) in place of the points the normal build spends elsewhere.
advantage: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing against other bosses, so the normal build spends those points elsewhere.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. The normal build skips it.
rotation: Uses the Combat Swords rotation (no Adrenaline Rush talent, so that line is skipped)
Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Blade Flurry on cooldown while Slice and Dice is up
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 5 combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6 s left); spend leftover points in the last 3 s
Sinister Strike right after a main-hand swing (0.5 s), or at 79+ energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder is damage only (+4%) and only against Humanoids and Giants
Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't active on the synthetic gear (about +8 and +6 for Combat Daggers).
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir left out for consistency (+8 through Dragonbreath Chili).
Best Alliance race is High Order. Since client 70425 the races are within about 3 DPS of each other.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as rogue__seal-fate-swords except talents, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeHumanoid, as the class preset's encounter does.
